community_paused.source: 队列暂停，等待服务检查

community_position.source: 数字为等待队列中的位置，按提交顺序执行。
community_position.en: The number is your position in the waiting queue. Tasks run in submission order.

community_restart.source: 服务重启中断了计算，可重新提交
community_restart.en: Computation was interrupted by a service restart. Submit again to retry.

community_rate.source: 提交过于频繁，请一分钟后重试
community_rate.en: Too many requests. Try again in one minute.

community_max.source: 当前浏览器最多保留{{0}}个未完成任务
community_max.en: This browser can keep up to {{0}} unfinished tasks.

community_network_max.source: 同一网络最多保留{{0}}个未完成任务，请等前面的任务完成
community_network_max.en: One network can keep up to {{0}} unfinished tasks. Wait for earlier tasks to finish.

community_names_hourly.source: 同一网络一小时内最多新建60组电极名称，请稍后再试
community_names_hourly.en: One network can create at most 60 electrode-name sets per hour. Try again later.

community_maintenance.source: 服务维护中，已有结果仍可读取；请稍后提交新计算
community_maintenance.en: The service is under maintenance. Existing results remain readable; submit new computations later.

community_refresh_retry.en: Refresh the page and try again.

server_busy.source: 服务器正忙，请稍后重试
server_busy.en: The server is busy. Try again later.

server_internal.source: 服务器内部错误，已记录；请稍后重试
server_internal.en: Internal server error. It has been logged; try again later.

server_bad_json.en: The request body is not valid JSON.

reception_saved_layout_invalid.source: 保存的信号布局坐标或区域标签无效
reception_saved_layout_invalid.en: The saved signal layout has invalid coordinates or region labels.

decision_restored_job.source: 已恢复离开前提交的坐标评价，正在继续查询进度。
decision_restored_job.en: Restored the coordinate evaluation submitted before you left; still checking its progress.

design_expand_to_compute.source: 展开调整参数并开始计算
design_expand_to_compute.en: Expand to adjust parameters and start a computation

community_full.source: 队列已满，请稍后提交；已有结果仍可读取
community_full.en: The queue is full. Submit later; saved results remain available.

community_missing.source: 任务不存在或不属于当前浏览器
community_missing.en: Task not found or not owned by this browser.

community_unsubscribe.source: 已退出共享任务，其他访客的计算继续
community_unsubscribe.en: You left the shared task. Computation continues for other visitors.

community_changed.source: 模型或代码已更新，请重新提交
community_changed.en: The model or code has changed. Submit again.

community_changed_queue.source: 排队后模型或代码已更新，请重新提交
community_changed_queue.en: The model or code changed while queued. Submit again.

community_unavailable.source: 计算队列不可用，请稍后重试
community_unavailable.en: The computation queue is unavailable. Try again later.

community_record.source: 计算记录无法读取，请重新提交
community_record.en: The saved result cannot be read. Submit again.

community_occupied.source: 计算资源被其他进程占用，请重新提交
community_occupied.en: Another process is using the computation resource. Submit again.

workspace13.source: 电极编辑副本 · 与原布局分开评价
workspace13.en: Electrode-edit copy · evaluated separately from its source

workspace14.source: 当前草稿 · 尚无匹配的布局评价
workspace14.en: Current draft · no matching layout evaluation

workspace16.en: Current record could not be loaded

workspace19.source: 编辑结果不进入固定64点信号协议
workspace19.en: Edited results use a separate protocol from fixed-64 signal simulation

workspace21.source: 导入已有64点坐标，评价后保存为独立布局；不运行区域布局搜索。
workspace21.en: Import 64 electrode coordinates and evaluate them as a separate layout, without running a region-layout search.

workspace23.source: 固定所选布局，检查网格位置偏移前后的重建表现；外部坐标在布局设计的坐标导入中评价。
workspace23.en: Keep the selected layout fixed and compare reconstruction before and after grid displacements. Evaluate external coordinates under Layout Design → Coordinate Import.

workspace25.source: 指定记录不支持此工具，请重新选择布局。
workspace25.en: The specified record is not supported by this tool. Select another layout.

workspace26.source: 已恢复本标签页的电极草稿；尚未重新评价。
workspace26.en: Restored this tab’s electrode draft; it has not been re-evaluated.

workspace27.source: 已恢复坐标草稿；尚未重新评价。
workspace27.en: Coordinate draft restored; it has not been re-evaluated.

workspace28.source: 从结果库查看已有实验；在布局设计中设置区域、编辑电极或导入坐标；在信号仿真中比较接收波形。使用指南与建模原理分别阅读。
workspace28.en: Explore existing experiments in Results Library; define regions, edit electrodes or import coordinates in Layout Design; compare received waveforms in Signal Simulation. The User Guide and Models & Methods remain separate documents.

workspace29.source: 坐标导入只执行当前坐标评价；位置偏移测试位于结果库的方案对比。
workspace29.en: Coordinate Import evaluates the current coordinates. Position displacement tests are available under Results Library → Layout Comparison.

workspace30.source: 坐标草稿无法恢复，请重新导入文件。
workspace30.en: The coordinate draft could not be restored. Import the file again.

workspace31.source: 当前标签页无法暂存坐标；离开前请保留原始文件。
workspace31.en: This tab cannot keep a temporary coordinate draft. Keep the original file before leaving.

workspace32.source: 电极草稿无法恢复，已载入所选布局。
workspace32.en: The electrode draft could not be restored. The selected layout has been loaded.

workspace33.source: 当前标签页无法暂存电极草稿；请手动保存后离开。
workspace33.en: This tab cannot keep a temporary electrode draft. Save it manually before leaving.

workspace34.source: 在结果库的“方案对比”中选择A、B，核对协议、实际面积与允许位置范围，再设置各项性能要求。可导出Markdown报告、完整JSON及64点CSV坐标。外部坐标文件在布局设计的“坐标导入”中评价；位置偏移测试保留在方案对比。
workspace34.en: Select layouts A and B under Results Library → Layout Comparison, check their protocols, actual areas and placement constraints, then set each performance requirement. Export a Markdown report, full JSON or 64-point CSV coordinates. Evaluate external coordinate files under Layout Design → Coordinate Import; position displacement tests remain in Layout Comparison.

workspace35.source: 已有电极坐标时，可直接进入坐标导入，上传CSV或JSON并评价；不必先运行区域布局搜索。
workspace35.en: If you already have electrode coordinates, open Coordinate Import, upload CSV or JSON and evaluate them directly, without first running a region-layout search.

allocation_adaptive_full.source: 跨区自适应配额（每区≥4，共64）
allocation_adaptive_full.en: Adaptive cross-region quota (min 4 per region, 64 total)

allocation_hint_adaptive.source: 每区至少保留 4 个锚点电极，其余通道按有效孔径与信噪比跨区自动调配。
allocation_hint_adaptive.en: Preserves at least 4 anchor electrodes per region and reallocates remaining channels across regions by effective aperture and SNR.

allocation_hint_balanced.source: 固定按 64/R 均分各区电极数，与面积和历史基线口径一致。
allocation_hint_balanced.en: Fixes 64/R electrodes per region, matching the area-budget and baseline protocol.

allocation_err_mode.source: 区域通道配额模式无效

allocation_err_single.source: 单区域不支持跨区自适应配额
allocation_err_single.en: Single-region layouts do not support adaptive cross-region quota.

allocation_progress_waterfill.source: 跨区信息配额注水初始化 {{0}}/{{1}}

fedorov_progress_round.source: 收敛交换与中心重填（起点 {{0}}/{{1}} · 第 {{2}} 轮）

objective_hint_composite.source: 联合优化下尾保留率、全脑场保留率与63维子空间互信息（0.55·min + 0.30·场 + 0.15·信息），为贴片内部电极提供持续空间去相关梯度。
objective_hint_composite.en: Jointly optimizes lower-tail retention, field retention and 63D subspace mutual information (0.55·min + 0.30·field + 0.15·info), providing continuous spatial decorrelation gradients for interior electrodes.

objective_hint_min.source: 最大化场重建与双极幅值下10%分位数的较小值 min(场, 幅值)，与默认基线完全一致。
objective_hint_min.en: Maximizes min(field, amplitude lower-10% tail), matching the default baseline protocol.

objective_err_mode.source: 搜索优化目标模式无效

community_empty_workspace.source: 此工作区暂无计算任务
community_empty_workspace.en: No computation tasks in this workspace

electrode_count_hint.source: 默认64导（与标准全头64导参考基线一致）；指定更少导联（如8、16、24、32导）可在固定贴片半径下测试通道饱和拐点。
electrode_count_hint.en: Default 64 channels (matching the full-scalp standard64 baseline); specify fewer channels (e.g., 8, 16, 24, 32) to map channel-saturation knees under a fixed patch radius.

allocation_hint_balanced_k.source: 固定按 K/R 均分各区电极数，与面积和历史基线口径一致。
allocation_hint_balanced_k.en: Fixes K/R electrodes per region, matching the area-budget and baseline protocol.

electrode_count_err_allowed.en: Total electrode count only supports 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, or 64.

electrode_count_err_adaptive.source: 跨区自适应配额要求电极总数至少为每区4导
electrode_count_err_adaptive.en: Adaptive cross-region quota requires at least 4 electrodes per region.

electrode_count_err_balanced.source: 电极总数不足以分配到所选区域数（每区至少2导）
electrode_count_err_balanced.en: Total electrode count is too small for the selected region count (at least 2 per region).

design_pending_no_layout_k.source: 本次搜索未找到完整布局。可扩大半径、减少电极总数或调整位置范围后再次计算。
design_pending_no_layout_k.en: No complete layout was found in this search. Increase the radius, lower the electrode count, or adjust the allowed placement domain and retry.

worker_no_layout_k.source: 在当前候选网格、4mm间距和有限搜索预算内，未构造出满足严格区域约束的{{0}}点布局；这不是数学不可行证明。
worker_no_layout_k.en: Within the current candidate grid, 4 mm spacing, and bounded search budget, no {{0}}-electrode layout satisfying strict region constraints was constructed; this does not certify mathematical infeasibility.
